content: {"kind":"plan","text":"居家徒手 30 分钟，按热身、主训练、放松排：先唤醒手腕、肩胛、肩袖，再练支撑臂、压缩、转体和髋外展这套托马斯基础链。没说明水平，按入门档排，每组 2 组；撑不住就把组数减到 1 组。","plan":{"schemaVersion":1,"source":"ai","title":"居家托马斯基础链","summary":"徒手练承重肩、锁肘支撑、核心压缩转体与髋外展，给托马斯打底。","goal":"fullbody","scene":"home","equipment":["mat"],"level":1,"targetMinutes":30,"avoid":[],"blocks":[{"id":"b1","name":"热身：手腕+肩胛","type":"warmup","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"forearms-A","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":10,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":15},{"exerciseId":"serratus-A","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":10,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":30},{"exerciseId":"rotator-cuff-A","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":8,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":30}]},{"id":"b2","name":"主训练：支撑与压缩","type":"main","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"triceps-A","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":8,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":45},{"exerciseId":"deltoids-A","mode":"time","sets":2,"workSeconds":25,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":30},{"exerciseId":"abs-A","mode":"time","sets":2,"workSeconds":20,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":30},{"exerciseId":"lats-A","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":8,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":45},{"exerciseId":"obliques-A","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":6,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":45},{"exerciseId":"hip-abductors-A","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":8,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":30},{"exerciseId":"glute-max-A","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":10,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":30}]},{"id":"b3","name":"放松：肩胛与后撑","type":"cooldown","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"scapular-A","mode":"reps","sets":1,"reps":8,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":30},{"exerciseId":"erectors-A","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":20,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":30}]}],"notes":["库里没有专门拉伸动作，放松块用低量肩胛活动和后撑抬髋代替。","压缩专项 hip-flexors-A 偏难（难度3），这次先不排；撑地稳了再加进主训练。","全程徒手+瑜伽垫，不需要其他器械。"],"safetyNotes":["撑地动作多，手腕或肩有酸胀就停下来活动手腕。","不适加重就停止训练。"]}}
